## Summary

Describe the problem and the change made to address it.

## Scope

- Affected skill or repository component:
- Supported execution domains affected:
- Out-of-scope behavior:

## Validation

List the exact local commands and GitHub Actions jobs used to validate the change.

## Security and compatibility

Describe any trust-boundary, path-routing, interpreter-selection, release, or backward-compatibility impact. Write `None` when there is no such impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and excludes unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] Behavioral changes include regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, generated archives, or machine-specific paths were added.
- [ ] No diagnostic path installs software or modifies project dependencies.
- [ ] The full applicable validation suite passes.
